fields.name: predictionId
fields.description: Prediction.deriveId(eventId, modelName, modelVersion): 64 lowercase hex, stable on replay

fields.name: eventId
fields.description: The scored feature vector's eventId: the join back to it

fields.name: eventTime
fields.description: The event's time, copied from the feature vector, ISO-8601 UTC

fields.name: sensor
fields.description: The sensor that captured the event

fields.name: connectionUid
fields.description: Zeek's connection uid, copied from the feature vector

fields.name: clientIp
fields.description: The stream's client: the device polling

fields.name: serverIp
fields.description: The stream's server: the device polled

fields.name: unitId
fields.description: The stream's Modbus unit id

fields.name: modelName
fields.description: The detector bundle's name

fields.name: modelVersion
fields.description: The detector bundle's version

fields.name: modelSha
fields.description: SHA-256 of the detector's model.onnx

fields.name: schemaId
fields.description: The feature schema scored, modbus-feature-v1

fields.name: schemaHash
fields.description: That schema's content hash

fields.name: verdict
fields.description: WARMUP (fewer than a full window in the stream's segment), NORMAL, ANOMALY, or UNSCORABLE (non-finite preprocessed input)

fields.name: denseScore
fields.description: Dense head reconstruction MAE; null unless NORMAL or ANOMALY

fields.name: temporalScore
fields.description: Temporal head endpoint MAE; null unless NORMAL or ANOMALY

fields.name: denseThreshold
fields.description: The bundle's dense threshold

fields.name: temporalThreshold
fields.description: The bundle's temporal threshold

fields.name: trigger
fields.description: NONE, DENSE, TEMPORAL or BOTH: which head exceeded its threshold

fields.name: windowEvents
fields.description: The window's size after this event, 0-20; unchanged by an UNSCORABLE event

fields.name: qualityFlags
fields.description: OR of this vector's quality flags and those of every vector in the window

fields.name: inferenceMicros
fields.description: Inference time in microseconds; 0 unless scored

fields.name: producedAt
fields.description: When the prediction was emitted, ISO-8601 UTC
